bead.title: repo-structure: slice 2 - move execute/runtime mechanics to internal/serviceimpl
bead.description: Move execute/runtime mechanics per ADR-008. Move metadata_billing.go, service_execute.go, service_execute_dispatch.go, service_harness_instances.go, service_model_resolution.go, service_models.go, service_native_provider.go, service_policies.go, service_projection.go, service_providers.go, service_reasoning.go, service_refresh_scheduler.go, service_routing.go, service_snapshot.go, service_status.go, and service_stale_harness_reaper*.go files to internal/serviceimpl along with their white-box tests. Maintain root package stability and keep allowlist test passing.
